facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but under CEMAC exchange control; repatriate earnings through your bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: No: residents can't open foreign-currency accounts locally; declare accounts abroad.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register an individual enterprise at the ANIE one-stop shop, target 72 hours.
facts.L2_tax_id: NIF from the tax administration; unregistered operators face a 15% prepayment.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Residents taxed on worldwide income; small businesses pay the IGL.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 18% VAT; exports are 0%; threshold not confirmed.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 007/PR/2015: declare data processing to ANSICE.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: E-commerce law requires clear seller information; no refund period found.
facts.D1_id_document: National identity card from ANATS, with your NNI number.

watch_out.text: Declare any accounts you hold abroad to the BEAC.
